chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Hamadani narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated to us from his father, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from his father Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father al-Baqir Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Zayn al-Abidin Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father the Master of Martyrs al-Husayn ibn Ali, from his father the Master of Deputies Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all). He said: Verily

the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) delivered a sermon to us one day and said: O people! The month of Allah has come to you with blessing, mercy, and forgiveness. It is a month that is considered by Allah to be the best of months. Its days are the best of days, its nights are the best of nights, and its hours are the best of hours. It is a month in which you were invited to be the guests of Allah, and you were made among the people of Allah's honour. In it, your breath is glorification, your sleep is worship, your deeds are accepted, and your supplications are answered. So ask Allah, your Lord, with sincere intentions and pure hearts, that He grant you success in fasting and reciting His Book. For indeed, the wretched is he who is deprived of Allah's forgiveness in this great month. Remember in your hunger

and your thirst in it the hunger and thirst of the Day of Resurrection. Give charity to your poor and needy, respect your elders, be merciful to your young, maintain ties of kinship, guard your tongues, lower your gaze from that which is forbidden to look at, withhold your ears from that which is forbidden to hear, show mercy to the orphans of the people so that mercy may be shown to your orphans, and repent to Allah from your sins. Raise your hands to Him in supplication at the times of your prayers, for that is the best time — Allah Almighty looks upon His servants with mercy therein, He answers them when they whisper to Him, He fulfils them when they call out to Him, He grants to them when they ask Him, and He responds to them when they supplicate to Him. O people! Your souls are mortgaged by your deeds, so free them through your seeking forgiveness. Your backs are heavy from your burdens, so lighten them through the length of your prostrations. Know that Allah, exalted be His remembrance, has sworn by His might that He will not punish

those who pray and prostrate, and He will not terrify them with the Fire on the Day when people stand before the Lord of the worlds. O people! Whoever among you feeds a fasting believer in this month will have, for that, before Allah the freeing of a slave and forgiveness for his past sins. So it was said: O Messenger of Allah! Not all of us are able to do that. So he (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: Protect yourselves from the Fire even with half a date, protect yourselves from the Fire even with a drink of water. O people! Whoever among you beautifies his character in this month will have a permit on the Bridge on the Day when feet will stumble. Whoever lightens the burden on what his right hand possesses in this month, Allah will lighten his reckoning for him. Whoever withholds

his evil in it, Allah will withhold His anger from him on the Day he meets Him. Whoever is generous to an orphan in it, Allah will be generous to him on the Day he meets Him. Whoever maintains ties of kinship in it, Allah will connect him to His mercy on the Day he meets Him. Whoever severs his ties of kinship in it, Allah will cut off His mercy from him on the Day he meets Him. Whoever performs voluntary prayers in it, Allah will write for him a dissociation from the Fire. Whoever performs an obligatory prayer in it, he will have the reward of one who performed seventy obligatory prayers in other months. Whoever increases his prayers upon me in it, Allah will make his scale heavy on the Day when scales are light. Whoever recites one verse from the Quran in it, he will have

the reward of one who completed the Quran in other months. O people! Indeed the gates of Paradise are open in this month, so ask your Lord not to close them for you. The gates of Hellfire are locked, so ask your Lord not to open them for you. The devils are chained, so ask your Lord not to unleash them upon you. Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: I stood up and said: O Messenger of Allah! What is the best deed in this month? So he said: O Abu al-Hasan! The best deed in this month is piety with regard to what Allah has forbidden, Exalted and Majestic be He. Then he wept. So I said: O Messenger of Allah! What makes you weep?

He said: O Ali! I weep over what will be violated against you in this month. It is as if I see you while you are praying to your Lord, when the most wretched of the former and latter peoples — the brother of the one who slaughtered the she-camel of Thamud — strikes you upon the crown of your head, from which your beard will be dyed with blood. Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: So I said: O Messenger of Allah! Will that occur while my religion is intact? So he said: While your religion is intact. Then he (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: O Ali! Whoever kills you has killed me, whoever hates you has hated me, and whoever insults you has insulted me,

because you are from me like my own self. Your spirit is from my spirit and your clay is from my clay. Truly, Allah the Blessed and Exalted created me and you, chose me and you, selected me for prophethood and selected you for the Imamate — so whoever denies your Imamate has denied my prophethood. O Ali! You are my deputy, the father of my descendants, the husband of my daughter, and my vicegerent over my nation in my lifetime and after my death. Your command is my command and your prohibition is my prohibition. I swear by Him who sent me with prophethood and made me the best of people: verily you are the Proof of Allah over His creation, His trustee over His secret, and His vicegerent over His servants.

key_terms.الصراط: The Bridge (al-Sirat) over Hellfire on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.الورع عن محارم الله: Abstaining from what God has forbidden -- identified as the best deed in Ramadan
key_terms.حجة الله: The Proof of Allah -- a theological term for the divinely appointed authority
key_terms.شقيق عاقر ناقة ثمود: The brother of the slayer of the she-camel of Thamud -- referring to Ibn Muljam, Ali's assassin
key_terms.ضيافة الله: The Banquet of Allah -- a metaphor for Ramadan as a divine invitation

ai.seo_question: What is the famous Sermon of Sha'ban about the month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This is the famous Sermon of Sha'ban (Khutbat al-Sha'baniyya), in which Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) delivered a sermon welcoming the month of Ramadan, narrated through the Golden Chain (Silsilat al-Dhahab) passing through all the Imams from al-Rida back to Imam Ali. He described Ramadan's extraordinary virtues -- that breaths in it count as glorification and sleep as worship -- and gave practical exhortations about fasting, charity, good character, family ties, and caring for orphans. The sermon culminated in a deeply emotional exchange where the Prophet wept foretelling Ali's martyrdom during Ramadan, and declared Ali's supreme station as his deputy, the proof of God over creation, and the one chosen by God for the Imamate just as the Prophet was chosen for prophethood.
